en: Vintage sepia multi‑view postcard with a patterned border. It shows three photographs: at the top, a large three‑storey school building behind a fence labeled in Bulgarian as a girls' gymnasium; in the middle, a park or open field with trees, a pavilion and a distant church tower, labeled Ayazmoto; at the bottom, a large Orthodox church with multiple domes, labeled as the Church of St. Nicholas. Along the bottom edge there is a greeting text indicating it is from Stara Zagora.
